findings.title: Database migrations run when the application starts
findings.whyItMatters: Deployz does not run a migration step of its own for this app — the running application updates its own database schema on boot.
findings.suggestedOutcome: No action needed — migrations run on application startup and Deployz monitors the app until it reports healthy.
findings.technicalEvidence: Migrations run at startup: go migrator call on the start path (pkg/initialize/init.go).
findings.plainEnglishExplanation: This app applies its database migrations when the application itself starts, not as a separate deploy step.
